config.rationale: Extends the best CNN (res_cnn_wide_d5, 0.9875) by adding one more residual block (depth 6) while keeping hidden at the 96 cap. Lower LR (6e-4 vs 8e-4) compensates for the extra depth to avoid instability. Dropout raised to 0.2 for the deeper stack. Brightness augmentation added to counteract the low channel stds (0.12-0.18) and reduce overfitting on the 90k samples. Cosine schedule and AdamW with 2e-4 weight decay match the prior best configuration.
